# Reverse Video

- Route: `/tools/reverse-video`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `video`
- Slug: `reverse-video`

## Summary

Play any clip backwards, with or without the audio reversed, and optionally ping-pong it forward then back. (Video tools)

## Details

The reversed-video effect is older than the internet and still works: shattered glass reassembling, a diver leaping out of the pool, a crowd un-dispersing. Media Manipulator reverses the frames and, optionally, the audio of any clip on our servers with FFmpeg, and the ping-pong option appends the forward copy so the result loops seamlessly, which is what most social and GIF uses want.
### What it does
- Reverses the video frames of any clip.
- Reverses the audio with it, or drops the audio for a silent result.
- Ping-pong mode plays forward then backward for a seamless loop.
- Exports MP4, WebM or an animated GIF.
### How to use it
1. Upload a clip: Short clips work best; reversing loads the whole clip in memory.
2. Choose reverse or ping-pong: Reverse is preselected.
3. Convert: FFmpeg reverses the frames and audio.
4. Download: MP4 for video, GIF for a loop.
### Supported formats
- Input: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, avi, m4v, flv, wmv
- Output: mp4, webm, mov, gif
### Technical details
- Reversal buffers every frame of the clip, so very long or 4K clips take longer and more memory; trim first for best results.
- Audio uses the areverse filter; for a silent reversed clip, remove the audio first.
- Ping-pong concatenates the forward and reversed streams, doubling the duration.
### Use cases
- Boomerang-style loop: Turn a two-second clip into a seamless back-and-forth.
- Reverse reveal: Play an unboxing or a build in reverse.
- Rewind transition: Reverse a few seconds to cut between scenes.
- Reversed GIF: Export straight to GIF for chat and forums.
### FAQ
Q: Is the audio reversed too?
A: Yes, by default. Remove the audio first if you want a silent clip.
Q: What is ping-pong?
A: The clip plays forward, then backward, so it loops without a visible jump.
Q: Is there a length limit?
A: Reversing holds the whole clip in memory. Clips of a minute or two are fine; trim longer videos first.
Q: Can I get a GIF?
A: Yes. Pick GIF as the output format; it is ideal for a ping-pong loop.
